items.title: 68190_Samuel
items.q: We jammed a lot when Baby and I were playing together in a big band; Thoman Hayes' band and also the band that changed to be the Kansas City Rockets, Harlan headed by Leonard.

ctx.x: I would guess then you jammed with Baby's band down there?

Of course. We jammed a lot when Baby and I were playing together in a big band; Thoman Hayes' band and also the band that changed to be the Kansas City Rockets, Harlan headed by Leonard. We would go down there and we'd still go there and jam; the same consequences.
You and Baby left Thoman Hayes to go with Harlan Leonard's Rockets, Harlan Leonard's band?
